description: Issues the Budget Call, evaluates proposals, prepares the President's budget, releases allotments and cash authority, and owns most budget systems.
Buys common-use supplies centrally and manages PhilGEPS with its Virtual Store and Electronic Marketplace.
Sets procurement rules. Its Technical Support Office receives the procurement plans and monitoring reports of all procuring entities.

Manages the cash of the national government and the Treasury Single Account, issues and services government securities, keeps the books of national cash and debt.
